[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=The Alkali Pan | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=446 }} [[The Alkali Pan]] is a flat sandy basin to the west of [[Palawa Joko]]'s [[Bone Palace]]. Ruins of an ancient place referred to as Morah litter the northwestern portion of this area. ==Getting there== {{TOCright}} The [[primary quest]] that will lead your party here from the [[Bone Palace]] is [[Horde of Darkness]]. Defiant]] → [["It's Just a Flesh Wound."]] ([[Churkeh's Defiance]]) ==Notes== {{gw2w}} *Complete exploration of the area contributes approximately 3.02% towards the Elonian [[Cartographer]] Title. *A pillar near [[Fumeai]] can be knocked down using [[Junundu Smash]], which opens an alternate route from the [[Bone Palace]] to [[the Shattered Ravines]]. *Before acquiring the [[Horde of Darkness]] quest, the passage in front of the [[Ruins of Morah (outpost)|Ruins of Morah]] exit will be closed; making it more difficult to get to the other side of the map. *These quests affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[Horde of Darkness]] **[[Strange Bedfellows]] **[[The Scourge of Vabbi]] **[[Under New Management]] ===Vanquisher=== *{{Vanquisher|count = 300|low = 281|high = 326}} **This area can be cleared while inside the relative safety of a [[Junundu]], with the exception of the rocky ground outside the two outposts and the [[boss]] group of [[Shelkeh the Hungry]]. **[[Shelkeh the Hungry]] is a [[mesmer]] boss and its group might have several [[Awakened Cavalier]]s. Skills that prevent [[resurrection]] (such as [[Frozen Soil]]) are useful to overcoming them. **For large awakened groups (the larger ones are on the sulfurous wastes), be sure to take down all [[Awakened Acolyte]]s and [[Awakened Cavalier]]s first. These groups can be difficult to take on, even while inside a Junundu. The Cavaliers have both [[Signet of Return]] and "[[We Shall Return!]]" so it is essential to keep killing them, or else they will maintain an infinite resurrection chain. **There are about a dozen spots in the sulfurous wastes where [[Desert Wurm (NPC)|Desert Wurm]]s are [[Popup|hidden]], with some having two of them appear at once. Make sure you sweep the area and proceed carefully before engaging [[undead]] or [[elemental]] groups. **Hidden [[mandragor]] groups can be found on the western rocky ground, the eastern sandy area, and the rocky northeastern corner. Proceed slowly to avoid engaging multiple groups. {{Explorable areas in the Desolation}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Das Alkalibecken]]
